wolfram.note: Series at Infinity is not implemented: ours stays the call. Wolfram is right, and its Indeterminate is the scan declining to compare a held series, not its answer: Series gives e^x (1/sqrt(2 pi x) + 1/(8 sqrt(2 pi) x^(3/2))), whose real part agrees with mpmath besseli to 8e-5 at x = 30 and 2e-5 at x = 60. It adds an imaginary e^(-x) term (beyond all orders, a Stokes ambiguity) that the real function does not have.
